title: Worm
wikitext:
[[image:Worm.png|thumb|]]
A slithering, segmented beast sometimes with what appears to be a tiny pair of limbs near its face.  Almost all worms are found inside cave-themed instances such as [[Maraudon]] or [[Ragefire Chasm]], but a few types of tiny worms live inside [[zombie]]s.  Strangely, some species of worms are skinnable, while others are not.

Giant Dredge Worms can be found in [[Silithus]].
